title: Every note becomes a warped arrangement clip at its place, pitch and level
description:
As a producer, I want every note of the score to become a warped arrangement clip at the same place, pitch and level, so that the set plays what the engine renders.

```gherkin
Feature: Notes become arrangement clips
  Background:
    Given the sample "horn.wav" with a steady beat at 120 BPM, tuned 30 cents sharp
    And the score "blues.apr":
      """
      tempo 100
      key F
      clip horn = horn.wav beats 0..8 warp beats
      chords I7 IV7
      track horn transpose 2 volume -3
      """

  Scenario: A note that crosses a chord change is two clips
    When I export "blues.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the track "horn" has 2 clips
    And clip 1 of "horn" starts at beat 0 and lasts 4 beats
    And clip 2 of "horn" starts at beat 4 and lasts 4 beats

  Scenario: Clips are warped onto the score's beats
    When I export "blues.apr" as a DAW set
    Then every clip of "horn" is warped in "Beats" mode
    And the warp markers of each clip pin the sample's beats to the score's beats

  Scenario: Transposition and tuning correction
    When I export "blues.apr" as a DAW set
    Then every clip of "horn" is transposed 2 semitones and detuned -30 cents

  Scenario: A tuning correction beyond half a semitone moves a whole semitone
    Given the sample "horn.wav" is tuned 70 cents flat
    When I export "blues.apr" as a DAW set
    Then every clip of "horn" is transposed 3 semitones and detuned -30 cents

  Scenario: Levels
    When I export "blues.apr" as a DAW set
    Then each clip's gain is its note's level match in dB
    And the track "horn" has volume -3 dB

  Scenario Outline: Warp modes
    Given the clip "horn" is warped with "<mode>"
    When I export "blues.apr" as a DAW set
    Then every clip of "horn" is warped in "<set mode>" mode
    Examples:
      | mode    | set mode                    |
      | beats   | Beats                       |
      | complex | as decided in design/daw-set.md |
      | texture | Texture                     |

  Scenario: A track that plays no notes is still exported
    Given the track "horn" plays only "bars 9-10" of an 8-bar score
    When I export "blues.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the set has an audio track "horn" with no clips
    And the export warns that "horn" plays no notes
```
